items.title: Amnesty International demands immediate release of CJP leaders, condemns Jantar Mantar denotification
items.summary: Amnesty International issued a formal press release on Oct 14 (published 9:37 PM IST) calling on Delhi authorities to immediately release CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, remanded to five days' judicial custody after trying to protest at Jantar Mantar. Amnesty International India board chair Aakar Patel said denotifying established protest sites and arresting people who use them shows 'strong authoritarian tendencies' and leaves the right to protest 'hollowed out in practice'. The statement also flags detentions of protesters travelling from Gujarat and Maharashtra and alleged mistreatment of journalists covering the protests. Maktoob Media covered the statement on Oct 15: 'Amnesty demands release of CJP leaders, says Jantar Mantar closure hollows out right to protest.' Catch-up: published before the pause baseline but never logged by earlier runs.

items.title: Dipke marks 'Day 3' of Das and Ranka's detention, calls it an 'illegal arrest' for waving the national flag
items.summary: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke posted on X on Oct 15: 'It's Day 3 of Ashu and Saurav's illegal arrest. Two young men who gave up their comfortable lives to fight for change are now languishing in jail. Imagine being jailed in your own country for waving your own national flag.' Delhi Police's stated position remains that the Oct-13 Jantar Mantar entry was trespass, breach of the Oct-11 peace bond, and repeated attempts to disturb public peace.

items.title: CJP's official Instagram reposts Oct-10 video, alleges takedown ('Dictator Modi deleted this video from October 10, so here it is again')
items.summary: The official @cockroachjantaparty account posted an Instagram story (~2:17 AM IST Oct 15) re-uploading a video from October 10 with the caption 'Dictator Modi deleted this video from October 10, so here it is again'. The takedown allegation itself is unverified; the republication is a new official-party communication.
